comments.body: You do not need to add `ubuntu-24.04-riscv` here since the builds for `aarch64` and `ppc64le` are done using QEMU on the `ubuntu-latest` runner. Simply add `riscv64` at https://github.com/riseproject-upstreaming/py-webrtcvad-wheels/pull/1/changes#diff-5c3fa597431eda03ac3339ae6bf7f05e1a50d6fc7333679ec38e21b337cb6721L33 and call it a day.

summary:
You do not need to add `ubuntu-24.04-riscv` here since the builds for `aarch64` and `ppc64le` are done using QEMU on the `ubuntu-latest` runner. Simply add `riscv64` at https://github.com/riseproject-upstreaming/py-webrtcvad-wheels/pull/1/changes#diff-5c3fa597431eda03ac3339ae6bf7f05e1a50d6fc7333679ec38e21b337cb6721L33 and call it a day.

The `CIBW_MANYLINUX_RISCV64_IMAGE` image is `manylinux_2_39_riscv64`
